spatial_support.claim_scope: Exploratory reanalysis on the explicitly amended numerical common support

design_quality.interpretation: Quality failures remain visible. Finite coefficients are exploratory descriptions; failed original gates do not support their original specificity/identification claim.

interpretation.scope: Exploratory within-session conditional-estimand sensitivity; no DDM mechanism, neural-process identification, independent replication, team-map or corrected voxel-inference claim.
interpretation.sampling_unit: participant; equal participant weights; half14 and half23 are paired repeated observations
interpretation.task_versions: EI and ER are descriptive between-participant strata with different offer ranges; their contrast is not a causal task-version effect.
interpretation.spatial_cosine: uncentered dot product divided by map L2 norms on the explicitly selected fixed common support; zero-norm maps are unavailable
interpretation.intervals: Student t95 confidence intervals for means of paired-within-participant derived scalars; no voxel independence assumption and no multiplicity correction
interpretation.ratios: Participant-wise RMS denominators explicitly named. Nonlinear RMS is computed after within-participant run averaging. These descriptive ratios are not original equivalence tests.
interpretation.missingness: Any required nonestimable arm propagates to dependent participant maps/metrics; the corresponding all-participant stratum result is unavailable, never a complete-case estimate.
interpretation.offer_omissions: Fixed-prediction equal-participant means after omitting each of 16 qualified version-specific offer groups, for all and its matching version. Overlapping descriptive influence subsets; no refits or template-generalization claim.
interpretation.maps: Unthresholded means and participant standard errors; outside the fixed group mask is NaN. No inferential t/z/p maps.
